summary: Short kerb by a crossing, no stopping sign, house 8 m away, steep.

best_section.where: Keltie Street south kerb, just west of the pedestrian crossing

drivers.seclusion: Homes 8 m and 12 m away on the same side, several more within 30 m.
drivers.access_and_room: Plain kerb on a through road; a couple of cars park near the crossing but room is short.
drivers.traffic: Busy two-way road with a marked crossing at the far end.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Any Time sign applies; no overnight stays visible.

flags: No Stopping Any Time sign 12 m off the kerb line
sun_shade: Open to the north and east; trees along the south side shade it from the afternoon.
